title: Local finite free maps lifting finite type generators
statement: Let X be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], V and K opens with K contained in V, H a module sheaf [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] whose restriction to K is of finite type [def-weil-pbc-module-finite-type-presentation], G a module sheaf on V, and p:G -> H|V an epimorphism. For every x in K there is a neighbourhood U contained in K, a natural number n, and a morphism l from the finite free module O_U^{n} to G|U such that l followed by p|U is an epimorphism. The source G is arbitrary; no generating family or finite-support subset is specified.

source.place: Modules, Definition 01B5 and Lemma 01B8, its proof choosing finite generators and lifting them locally. Read https://stacks.math.columbia.edu/tag/01B8.

proof.text: Use Mathlib SheafOfModules.IsFiniteType.exists_localGeneratorsData for H.over K. Evaluate its covering sieve at x, using Sieve.overEquiv_iff, to choose an object A of Over K whose underlying open contains x. Its generators have finite index type. Reindex it by ULift (Fin n) via Fintype.equivFin and freeFunctor.mapIso. Push the generating epimorphism through Over.iteratedSliceBackward using SheafOfModules.pushforward; this equivalence of slice sites preserves colimits. The componentwise identity isomorphisms flattenModuleIso and flattenUnitIso identify the target with H.over A and its unit with the unit on A. Mathlib mapFreeIso gives a finite free epimorphism q to H.over A. This is the proved private lemma finite_generator_epi.

For p on the slice over V, the existing Mathlib/WeilConjectures functor SheafOfModules.toSheaf preserves finite colimits and hence epimorphisms. Apply Mathlib CategoryTheory.Sheaf.isLocallySurjective_iff_epi' to its map of p. For any section on A, the image sieve is therefore covering. Unfold the topology on Over V through Sieve.overEquiv; evaluate the resulting open covering at x and use Sieve.overEquiv_iff to obtain a neighborhood B inside A and a section of G on B mapping to the prescribed restricted section. This is local_section_lift, proved directly from the Mathlib criterion, with no additional project lemma.

Apply local_section_lift to each of the finitely many sections freeHomEquiv q i evaluated at the terminal object of Over A. Let U be A intersected with the finite infimum of the resulting B_i. The point lies in U, and U is contained in every B_i; Opens.coe_iInf proves membership. For the empty index type this infimum is top, so U=A. Restrict each lift to every object of Over U. PresheafOfModules.map_comp_apply proves that these restrictions form global sections t_i of G restricted to U. Define l by freeHomEquiv.symm t.

By the free coproduct universal property, compare l followed by p on U with the restriction of q preceded by mapFreeIso. On the i-th coproduct injection, use ιFree_mapFreeIso_hom, unitHomEquiv, and Equiv.apply_symm_apply to reduce the equality to the section equation. Naturality of p, the local lifting equation for g_i, functoriality of restriction, and the naturality property of the generating section prove it on every slice object. Thus the composite equals mapFreeIso.hom followed by overMap.map q. Both morphisms are epi: the first is an isomorphism and overMap is left adjoint, so it preserves the epi q. The generic private finite_free_lift is specialized to moduleRings X.toRingedSpace. All helpers are proved and no new obligations remain.

proof_origin.place: Definition 01B5 and Lemma 01B8, proof choosing finite generators and shrinking until they lift; implemented using the general Mathlib slice-site local-surjectivity criterion and free coproduct universal property.

mathlib_searches.query: An epimorphism to a finite type sheaf locally has an epimorphic composite from a finite free sheaf
A finite type sheaf target of an epimorphism admits locally a map from a finite free sheaf into the source with epimorphic composite
mathlib_searches.results: Read SheafOfModules.GeneratingSections.ofEpi, IsFiniteType.exists_localGeneratorsData, freeHomEquiv, freeSection. None provides this local lift or finite-support factorization.
GeneratingSections.ofEpi maps generators forward; freeMap and its basis formulas describe inclusions. Neither constructs the required local factorization.

Two unrelated free monoid/group results in Mathlib/GroupTheory/Finiteness.lean. Read module-sheaf Generators.lean, Free.lean and PushforwardContinuous.lean. Library and blueprint searches found no statement of these local factors.

from.place: The finite-generation step of the affine-union construction in the H1 constructible representation: choose a finite support locally near each point before compactness selects a finite subcover. Part: Local finite free maps lifting finite type generators.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_finite_free_local_lift
    (X : Scheme.{u}) (V K : X.Opens) (hKV : K ≤ V)
    (H : SheafOfModules.{u} (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace))
    [(H.over K).IsFiniteType]
    (G : SheafOfModules.{u} ((moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over V))
    (p : G ⟶ H.over V) [Epi p] (x : K) :
    ∃ (U : X.Opens) (hUK : U ≤ K), (x : X) ∈ U ∧ ∃ (n : ℕ)
      (l : free (R := (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace).over U) (ULift.{u} (Fin n)) ⟶
        (overMap (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace) (homOfLE (hUK.trans hKV))).obj G),
      Epi (l ≫ (overMap (moduleRings X.toRingedSpace)
        (homOfLE (hUK.trans hKV))).map p)
